definitions.short: Ephah , the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess
definitions.full: H5891. Ephah II. עֵיפָה proper name 1. of a people 'son' of Midian Gen 25:4 (J) = 1Chr 1:33 , compare Isa 60:6 , ᵐ5 Γαφερ , Γεφαρ , Γαιφα ( ρ ). 2. masculine name in Judah 1Chr 2:47 , ᵐ5 Γαιφα . 3. feminine concubine of Caleb 1Chr 2:46 , ᵐ5 Γαιφαηλ , A Γαιφα ἡ , ᵐ5 L Γαιφα .
